course.title: Khaemenes Academy First Grade — 36 Unit A+ Curriculum
course.subtitle: Universal First Grade Readiness · In-House Curriculum · Advanced Whole-Child Foundation
course.dependencyPolicy: No outside fonts, scripts, images, libraries, or curriculum calls. All pages use local files only.
course.localReviewNote: Designed to exceed a single-state checklist by spanning broad first-grade domains. Families, schools, or evaluators should still review local compliance requirements.

standardsFamilies.label: Developmentally Appropriate First Grade Practice
standardsFamilies.description: Joyful, strengths-based, active learning with explicit instruction, practice, play, talk, movement, and reflection.

standardsFamilies.label: Grade 1 English Language Arts
standardsFamilies.description: Foundational skills, phonics, fluency, literature, informational text, writing, language, speaking, and listening.

standardsFamilies.label: Grade 1 Mathematics
standardsFamilies.description: Addition/subtraction, place value, measurement, data, geometry, time, fractions as equal shares, reasoning, and problem solving.

standardsFamilies.label: Grade 1 Science and Engineering
standardsFamilies.description: Light, sound, plants, animals, weather, Earth materials, patterns, design, observation, evidence, and safe investigations.

standardsFamilies.label: Grade 1 Social Studies and Civics
standardsFamilies.description: Families, communities, maps, culture, time, civic symbols, service, economics, goods/services, responsibilities, and history.

standardsFamilies.label: Social-Emotional Learning
standardsFamilies.description: Self-awareness, self-management, social awareness, relationship skills, responsible decision-making, confidence, repair, and persistence.

standardsFamilies.label: Arts, Music, Drama, and Creative Expression
standardsFamilies.description: Creating, performing, responding, connecting, rhythm, visual design, storytelling, movement, critique, and portfolios.

standardsFamilies.label: Health, Movement, and Physical Development
standardsFamilies.description: Fine/gross motor, balance, coordination, safe movement, nutrition, hygiene, rest, health choices, and body confidence.

standardsFamilies.label: Tools, Technology, and Unplugged Computing
standardsFamilies.description: Safe tool use, digital citizenship, sequence, algorithms, debugging, creative communication, and computational thinking.

standardsFamilies.label: Portfolio, Assessment, and Communication
standardsFamilies.description: Weekly evidence, performance checks, midterm, final, self-reflection, family communication, and teacher documentation.
